mapper.sql: select id, question_id, user_id, code, content, language, answer_type, status, is_success, runtime, memory_usage, note, create_time from portal_interview_submission
mapper.select: select count(*) from portal_interview_submission where question_id = #{questionId}
select count(*) from portal_interview_submission where question_id = #{questionId} and is_success = true
SELECT * FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND is_featured = 1 AND note IS NOT NULL AND note != '' ORDER BY featured_time DESC
SELECT * FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT s.user_id AS user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, COUNT(DISTINCT s.question_id) AS passed_count, COUNT(*) AS submit_count FROM portal_interview_submission s LEFT JOIN portal_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.is_success = 1 GROUP BY s.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar ORDER BY passed_count DESC, submit_count ASC, s.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.user_id AS user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_success = 1 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) AS score, COUNT(*) AS submit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_count FROM portal_interview_submission s LEFT JOIN portal_user u ON u.id = s.user_id GROUP BY s.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar ORDER BY score DESC, submit_count ASC, s.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_success = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = 1 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END), 0) FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE is_success = 1 GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) > ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_success = 1 )) t

SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM portal_interview_submission GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = 1 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) > ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = 1 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END), 0) FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} )) t
mapper.update: UPDATE portal_interview_submission SET is_featured = #{isFeatured}, featured_time = CASE WHEN #{isFeatured} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id}
